description: The ETFIQ benchmarks: published, rules-based yardsticks for model portfolios (strategic, tax-aware, factor, income, tactical, thematic families, by stock share). Filter by family or band, then get_benchmark. Not a single fund's own benchmark (etf_profile). Never a recommendation; custom portfolios are build_portfolio.

band.description: Optional: a band id (such as moderate), all stocks, all bonds, or a stock share such as 60 or 60/40.

family.description: Optional: a benchmark family, by id or name.

name: list_benchmarks

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
